description:
Activate Peregrin Took by sacrificing three Foods.
Jenny Flint triggers three times.
Resolve the first Jenny Flint trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue and Food token due to Peregrin Took.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Resolve the Peregrin Took ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
